reason: The blanks need firing to make a stronger floor material for the pressure liner.
expectation: The solar heating bay will fire the blanks into usable floor pieces, though they may need further preparation.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric might protect the liner, but firing the floor material addresses the goal more directly.

effect: The fired blocks are suitable for non-pressure paving, so I can use them to prepare the growing bay floor.
reaction: The distinction between paving and a pressure structure is useful.
reason: Placing the ceramic blocks in the cleared bay should progress the safe-floor goal.
expectation: The blocks will form a paved base for the liner, possibly needing a protective layer afterward.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric may make that protective layer, but the floor base comes first.
